name: Toudou Kasane
source:
Kasane is a middle school student who is [url=/c4747]Tsumugi[/url] and [url=/c4743]Koyori's[/url] youngest sister. Cheery and playful, Kasane is best known for indulging in the rumor and gossip of the town, earning her the nickname "Fast ears". Kasane is a fellow schoolmate of [url=/c4752]Ayumu[/url] and is a good friend of his.

[Edited from [url=http://www.http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Hoshizora_e_Kakaru_Hashi_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
